subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Check-In Before the Deadline
description: Learn The Check-In Before the Deadline in one minute.

hook.text: He submitted the final draft at the deadline. His boss wanted a completely different direction. All time wasted.

buildup.text: Working in isolation until the deadline is a gamble. Requirements and priorities shift constantly.

discovery.text: A checkpoint at 30% completion catches misalignment before you have invested too much effort in the wrong direction.

twist.text: Sharing rough work feels vulnerable. But a quick draft check saves more credibility than a polished wrong deliverable.

climax.text: After 30% completion, share a quick outline or draft. Say: 'Am I on the right track?' Correct course early.

punchline.text: Check direction at 30%. Course-correct is cheap there.

quiz.question: Why should you check in at 30% completion?
options: To show your boss you have started the work
To catch misalignment before investing too much effort
To request an extension on the original deadline
